build_task_template: build a PHYRE task template with static bars and a dynamic ball using define_task_template decorator
create_static_bar: create a static bar obstacle with set_angle, set_bottom, and set_right positioning methods
create_dynamic_ball: create a dynamic ball object with set_center_x and set_bottom positioning in the scene
